newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT says to launch international network service.
newsitem.headline: NTT says to launch international network service.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp, whose business is limited by law to domestic services, plans to launch an international computer network service next January, a top executive at NTT said on Friday in interview.
"Our new service will be connected to international networks, or it will be too inconvenient to users," said Masamichi Tanabe, NTT's senior vice president in charge of multimedia service.
In February 1996, NTT said it would launch an Internet-like computer network service, called Open Computer Network, using routers instead of an expensive exchange system, early 1997.
But NTT had not said whether the network would be connected to international services due to a conflict with the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications Ministry over on-off plans to break up NTT.
